verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish a developer API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing portal flows (search, filing, ordering copies behind a credential account) and a 'Data and Image Subscriptions' link with no detail. Nothing documents API endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits, and the probes show the main site is bot-walled rather than exposed as a documented machine interface.
